title: ガラス入り店舗入口ドア
description: 少し開いたガラス戸、アルミ枠、気密パッキン、丁番、引手、浅い敷居と上部クローザーを備えた店舗入口。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A slightly open glazed entry with aluminum framing, transparent glass, compression seals, hinges, pull handles, shallow threshold and closer. Static visual prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
